Event Order API (POS) is a set of APIs for order messages and their optimised TMS routes. 

It works by sending new orders, updates or cancels to provide the TMS with the most up to date order book that instantly updates to follow the ebb and flow of your sales. 

It includes the completed Plan message showing how Event planned the orders into routes. 

A customer can place an order at any time. 

The NEW order is usually triggered through the Event Order API when it has a stock allocation and the order is confirmed, which can be 3, 4 or more days before the due collection date, or 1 or 2 days. 

The planning cycle generally expects to receive the orders the day before collection is due for optimisation, carrier allocation and notification. 

A basic order flow would be an order with multiple order lines triggered to Event through Event Order. 

Event will validate the order, plan the order and trigger back a route informing you how and when the order will be collected. 

It includes Order message (OMF), Plan return, NEW order, Order accepted, UPDATE order, Order accepted, and COMPLETE order.
